clusters.headline: Gadi Eisenkot Receives Mandate To Form Israel's New Government
aiSummaryBullets: Presidential mandate grants Gadi Eisenkot six weeks to build a coalition government.
The former military chief has initiated outreach to potential allies, including figures associated with Benjamin Netanyahu.

clusters.headline: Gadi Eisenkot Pursues Coalition Talks Following Israeli Elections
aiSummaryBullets: Gadi Eisenkot has been appointed to lead the formation of a new government following the recent Israeli elections.
Eisenkot indicated an openness to including the outgoing prime minister's party and some far-right allies in a coalition under his leadership.

clusters.headline: Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot begins the hard work of forging a coalition government
aiSummaryBullets: France 24 reports: Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot begins the hard work of forging a coalition government
Al Jazeera reports: Israeli opposition leader warns of ‘point of no return’ for democracy
